literal: shunning is-needed glory fading doing-action 'we-will-prosper' who-say they
translation: Those who say to themselves, 'We will prosper,' must shun actions that would dim their glory.
modern: நாம் வாழ்வில் மேன்மை அடைவோம் என்று எண்ணுபவர்கள், தம் புகழைக் கெடுக்கும் செயல்களைச் செய்வதை விட்டுவிட வேண்டும்.
explanation: The couplet advises ambitious individuals on the importance of pure actions. The word 'ஆஅதும்' (we will prosper) captures the mindset of those who wish to rise in life. To achieve true success, they must avoid 'ஒளி மாழ்கும் செய்வினை', which means actions that tarnish their 'ஒளி' (light or glory). Even if a bad action seems to offer a shortcut, it will ultimately destroy their reputation and must be strictly shunned ('ஓஒதல் வேண்டும்').
